purpose: Unimplemented reward-design dispositions and public policy/effect contract proposals for 53 selected development cases; not scorer labels, training targets or all-task acceptance.
basis: Final immutable development index contains 700 retained episodes; coverage accounts for all 709 with nine interrupted artifact-loss gaps. All 700 source SHA values independently checked. 53 selected policy/action cases have proposals; three execution failures are covered separately.
policy_boundary: Official assertions and official scalar scores are not policy-authoring inputs. Task constants below are independently extracted from public instructions and policy candidates. No reserved payloads are used.

reusable_adapters.responsibility: Bind source SHA, episode, trace and invocation; qualify captured before/after worlds and acknowledgement without declaring business success.
not_inferred: Policy permission
Real-world delivery from a prose claim
Complete world coverage from an empty query

reusable_adapters.responsibility: Resolve created or updated native objects and exact field deltas; preserve distinct occurrences and duplicate created objects.
not_inferred: Goal completion from success=true
Policy relevance from a changed field
New accomplishment from an unchanged retry

reusable_adapters.responsibility: Distinguish send, draft, post, response and failure; bind recipient/channel/thread/content and native message ID.
not_inferred: Recipient read the message
Referenced transfer or deployment occurred
A Re: subject proves native thread linkage

reusable_adapters.responsibility: At a specified evidence cutoff, link a completion claim to an earlier qualifying effect with matching entity, purpose and destination.
not_inferred: A future send validates an earlier Sent claim
Acknowledgement necessarily proves delivery beyond the simulator contract

reusable_adapters.responsibility: Keep event occurrence identity separate from task-defined entity/purpose/window obligation identity; cap accomplishment once while retaining every effect.
not_inferred: Identical argument JSON means duplicate delivery
Different JSON means different business obligations

reusable_adapters.responsibility: Normalize explicitly authorized offsets to instants, compare duration/calendar/attendees, and retain scheduling abstraction.
not_inferred: Host timezone resolves an ambiguous 3 PM
Event creation proves attendance or invitation delivery

reusable_adapters.responsibility: Use declared exact decimal arithmetic, denominators, rounding and selection sets; preserve verbatim source strings independently.
not_inferred: Correct aggregate implies correct entity amounts
Real tax law or an external clock fills missing policy

reusable_adapters.responsibility: Prefer deterministic structured fields, entity joins and explicit content constraints. Use reviewed parsers or finite semantic equivalences for prose; only a separately justified residual semantic question may use a bounded judge.
not_inferred: Keywords prove approval or commitment
Judge can resolve missing authority or facts
Unclear policy should be sent to a judge

reusable_adapters.responsibility: Identify a native draft object separately from a sent message and from monetary processing.
not_inferred: Draft creation transfers money

reusable_adapters.responsibility: Declare and qualify the simulator's payment, credit, void or release abstraction before interpreting its receipt.
not_inferred: A worksheet status is a bank transfer

reusable_adapters.responsibility: Bind published object, account, exact asset and requested content; distinguish preparation from publication.
not_inferred: Publishing proves compliance approval

reusable_adapters.responsibility: Bind sent envelope, template and signer identities.
not_inferred: Sent means signed

reusable_adapters.responsibility: Bind accepted conversion payload, destination and business key; retain failures and duplicate attempts.
not_inferred: An uploaded conversion proves attribution causality

reusable_adapters.responsibility: Bind native attachment reference to the required file evidence.
not_inferred: A body filename or attachment claim proves a file was attached

reusable_adapters.responsibility: Expose qualified action-log evidence when independent target state is absent, under an explicit environment abstraction.
not_inferred: Any action log automatically proves requested state

reusable_adapters.responsibility: Compare declared source threads, comments and attachments to their destination mapping.
not_inferred: Copying Description preserves every part of history

coverage_contract.priority: Deterministic source, policy and effect checks first. Do not use a judge to settle authority, candidate population, time, missing data or service behavior.
recording_procedure: Enumerate native invocation starts and require exactly one terminal outcome per occurrence within the assessed cutoff, with explicit active/aborted/missing cases.
Bind invocation arguments, terminal result, captured before/after worlds and write acknowledgement to the same source, trace and invocation. Distinct repeated calls remain distinct.
Check capture order and continuity; reconcile initial world plus acknowledged deltas against final world for each required service and object scope.
Normalize only schema-declared unordered sets. Do not hide arbitrary list ordering, unsupported fields, capture gaps or state conflicts.
coverage_procedure: Declare candidate entity universe, required services and business/observation windows before assessing absence.

For source-owned finite fixtures, enumerate all relevant initial records and qualifying subsequent changes. For paginated reads, require terminal pagination and all relevant filters/partitions; empty one-query results alone do not close scope.
Use complete invocation/ACK/capture coverage and initial/final reconciliation to prove no required or prohibited effect in the declared scope.
A recorded domain failure with a qualified no-change capture can prove that occurrence did not apply. It does not imply all task coverage is unavailable or rule out a later successful retry.
Record each gap at the narrowest affected service, entity, occurrence, predicate and cutoff. Independent supported findings remain valid.
True policy ambiguity requires a public contract or fixture revision before the affected labels; it is not sent to a judge by default.
coverage_contract.absence_rule: No absence-to-pass inference without closed coverage of the declared candidate/service/window scope.

status_semantics.verified: Predicate supported by sufficient qualified evidence
status_semantics.contradicted: Predicate false on sufficient qualified evidence
status_semantics.not_checked: Coverage or predicate check has not been executed
status_semantics.unavailable: A specified missing/conflicting input prevents this predicate; preserve the reason and affected scope
status_semantics.policy_unresolved: Public authority or meaning must be authored before this predicate can produce a label
